[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Overnight Oats: Mix rolled oats, milk, and toppings; refrigerate overnight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Muffin Tin Frittatas: Whisk eggs and veggies, bake in muffin tins.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Chia Seed Pudding: Mix chia seeds with milk; refrigerate overnight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Breakfast Quesadillas: Fill tortillas with eggs, beans, cheese, and veggies; refrigerate or freeze.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Green Smoothie Packs: Freeze fruits and spinach in bags; blend in the morning.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Cinnamon Roll Oatmeal: Cook oatmeal with cinnamon; refrigerate or freeze portions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Veggie and Cheese Scramble: Scramble eggs with veggies and cheese; refrigerate or freeze.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Mason Jar Granola: Mix oats, nuts, and seeds; refrigerate or freeze individual portions.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided ingredients for Overnight Oats:
